scheduling-baseline.description: Run Harbour-FL without a scheduling action to establish orchestration overhead

same-node-recovery.description: Force a controlled vessel-2 restart and verify that FL resumes

capacity-rebalance.description: Select the least-allocated eligible alternate node, with an explicit same-node fallback

multi-node-relocation.description: Require vessel-2 relocation to a distinct eligible node; skip when the cluster has no alternative

constraint-rejection.description: Verify safe refusal when placement constraints leave no eligible target
